data.body: Final live evidence for change 2928: submitted and merged at 2026-09-10T00:49:46Z after LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 on PS4. GitHub mirror caught up to merged Gerrit main 101e7833aa99f. Host /opt/rebar has the merged review-bot/config changes and compose-review-bot-1 is healthy. Snapshot before refs/meta/config repair: snap-07fbdcb440138c063. refs/meta/config:webhooks.config now matches the tokenless internal-origin template (no unsupported header). Smoke at 2026-09-10T~01:12Z: posting a Gerrit comment produced review-bot access log `POST /webhook HTTP/1.1` 202 Accepted from 172.21.0.4, and /review/health webhook_auth_rejections stayed 0 before/after. RCA: deployed Gerrit 3.14 webhooks plugin never emitted configured X-Rebar-Token; the prior hardening removed URL token auth and relied on an unsupported header. Fix class: keep public token auth, authenticate Gerrit deliveries by verified internal origin + peer, and page on auth rejects.
